title: Sinusoidal Measurement (PLL)
text: 使用锁相环估计正弦特征，输入 1 路、输出 3 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Phase detector integral gain} 指定 PD 积分增益、{Loop filter proportional gain} 指定 LF 比例增益、{Loop filter integral gain} 指定 LF 积分增益、{Initial frequency (Hz)} 指定 Initial frequency、{Initial phase angle (rad)} 指定初始相位、{Initial magnitude} 指定初始幅值，按实例取值。

ports.name: u
ports.summary: 输入信号 scalar or vector

params.name: Phase detector integral gain
params.values: PD 积分增益 1000 (default) | positive scalar or vector

params.name: Loop filter proportional gain
params.values: LF 比例增益 400 (default) | positive scalar or vector

params.name: Loop filter integral gain
params.values: LF 积分增益 20000 (default) | positive scalar or vector

params.name: Initial frequency (Hz)
params.values: Initial frequency 60 Hz (default) | scalar or vector

params.name: Initial phase angle (rad)
params.values: 初始相位 0 rad (default) | scalar or vector

params.name: Initial magnitude
params.values: 初始幅值 1 (default) | scalar or vector

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | 0 | positive scalar
